description: Refresh of the CIP headline comparisons under the adopted recommended construction: flat fee versus the mechanism with the 0.75 standard target, the 10-block processed-block standard window, and the age-escape reset at certification. The window length and the reset rule were selected by the standard-window screen (seeds 0-99), bounded by the announcement-semantics smoke (seeds 440-449), and confirmed on disjoint seeds (700-799). The runner applies each of the five headline load profiles to this manifest, using ten paired seeds and 2,000 slots without retaining event traces.
